guitar.notes: Well documented: Martin acoustics for folk era, Fender Stratocaster famously at Newport 1965. Entry is accurate.

tone.summary: Clean signal chain focusing on minimal coloration: Gate -> Comp -> Clean Boost (optional) -> US Deluxe -> US 2x12. Minimal reverb for space, no modulation or overdrive.
corrections: Original recording is acoustic guitar only
Remove all electric amp and effect suggestions
Target sparse dry folk texture not electric tone

rig.name: Bob Dylan - Blowin' in the Wind - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and finger noise.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean folk tones.

blocks.purpose: Even out the dynamics of acoustic strumming/fingerpicking.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for smoothing dynamic range without adding grit.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No overdrive or distortion needed for dry folk tone.
Provide a clean, articulate, and non-colored tone suitable for acoustic simulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the cleanest option available that still provides enough body to sound full in an FRFR context.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a small, intimate acoustic-electric pickup sound.
blocks.gap: While dedicated acoustic IRs are better, the US 2x12 provides the necessary clean and focused character.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the upper mids and highs to enhance string clarity and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: Used for fine-tuning the acoustic character, emphasizing articulation over warmth.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or wah needed for dry folk tone.
Bypass. Modulation effects (Chorus/Tremolo) are explicitly avoided.
Add subtle space and dimension without sounding artificial or distracting.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to mimic natural room reflections, keeping the tone dry.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal sense of space and intimacy without sounding like a large hall.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is the most natural choice for an intimate folk setting, keeping decay short.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic cabinet simulation with a dedicated acoustic IR for better realism.

proposals.recommendedAsset: dedicated acoustic guitar IR (e.g., EMT 140 or specific piezo mic)
proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is too electric; a dedicated IR will improve the dry, intimate sound.
